description: Content-address the exact reviewed external-verifier bootstrap package bytes before external handoff without treating a repository-local manifest as proof of Git provenance, external receipt, administrator independence, nonce consumption, or runtime attestation.
negative_controls: any bootstrap byte change changes package_content_hash
declared source commit change changes package_content_hash
verification_limit: The local manifest binds exact bytes to a declared commit value. It does not independently verify that the bytes are members of that Git commit or that an external operator received or accepted the package.
next_gate: The external operator independently retrieves and verifies the exact content-addressed package, then returns Evidence from the separately administered boundary.
